release: Komorebi Physics Lean v0.39.0 — Checked Block 39

claims.statement: The Hilbert adjoint of the checked cube-to-octree isometric pullback satisfies U†U = I.
The closed transported finite-prefix Euclidean levels are nested.
Every Euclidean-cube L² field is approximable by one transported finite-prefix level, and the union is dense.
Each level has a contractive idempotent orthogonal projection that is a best approximation and is consistent under refinement.
For every Euclidean-cube L² field f, the finite-resolution projections P_n f converge strongly to f.

nonclaims: The transported level V_n has not been identified with the ordinary half-open Euclidean dyadic-box step subspace.
No almost-everywhere inverse to binary or octree decoding is constructed.
The cube-to-octree pullback is not claimed to be surjective or unitary onto all octree L².
The levels are not claimed finite-dimensional for an arbitrary Hilbert fiber E.
No discrete Dirac generator consistency or propagator convergence theorem is proved in this block.
No empirical physical prediction or experimental validation is claimed.
